2mm is an explicit compliant-belt approximation, not a calibrated material model or real-robot safety bound.
The1mm raw diagnostic and all force data are preserved; selected-policy pass is not universal physical truth.

Released floor penetrations20.173mm(190) and13.910mm(133) are outside the operational stop policy; do not treat them as validated landing physics.
CPU133 is faster than GPU133 in this N=1 measurement and passes the selected policy only in posthoc classification; no GPU single-world speed victory is claimed.
CPU/GPU share physical MJB and model-array hashes but their evolving states and detachment counts differ.
Instrumented witnesses are excluded from clean throughput ranking.
Contact solve geometry/forces precede integration, local centers use refreshed post-integration poses, cached attachment state precedes current release, and timestamp is step-end.
